decisions.reason: Premium customer support sits at the center of the firm's existing service know-how, and its close fit with hosting operations makes it easy for the firm to learn from customer feedback and improve it commercially.

The software version management tool is strongly related to the firm's technical hosting and website administration capabilities, so its absorptive capacity for refining and integrating this product is high even if continued uptake is somewhat uncertain.

The data processing contract tool is useful to customers but is more peripheral to the firm's core hosting and infrastructure knowledge base, making it harder to sustain advantage and learn its way to a stronger position than in core services.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship offer that directly builds on the firm's core assets in data center capacity, platform development, support, and agency-focused service, so management would strongly favor continuing it.
